description: Call this whenever the user gives you, or your web search finds, a hotel's website. Pass its domain or URL. For a VibeBooking hotel it answers the hotel id and its agent page, which get_hotel, get_rates and book_link take; for any other hotel, its own site to send the traveller to and, when we have probed it, its agent-readiness level and the kinds of surface an agent can use there. A hotel name alone cannot be resolved: find its website first.

domain_or_name.description: The hotel's website domain or URL, such as inn.example.jp. A name alone is not enough.

name: resolve_hotel
title: Resolve a hotel website
